comparison_scope: Fixed learned rule deployed without reoptimisation on original160000-outcome law; same72 reference distributions and candidate-dependent denominator

baseline_audit.reason: Final policies include later refinement/recovery; some jobs overlap and one refinement failed. Individual cumulative hardware-counter intervals are measured, but summing these records would double-count overlap. No single clean total for the final best complete solve is asserted.
baseline_audit.energy_scope: Gross CPU package and GPU board; includes idle/background and excludes other components. Not measured wall-socket electricity.

failed_attempts.reason: Pipeline originally treated infeasible common-law deployment as an exception; now retained as an explicit failed feasibility outcome

numerical_commands_accounting.scope: Matched numerical commands include startup, loading, supervised waiting and first-repeat full-law validation. Gaps, software preparation, pilot, rendering and publication are excluded from command sums. Wall span includes gaps; energy for gaps is not inferred. Concurrent publication intervals are not added.
